card.name: First digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit of a two-digit number such as 40, 24, 20 or 35, usually an age or a dose, just before the second digit appears.

modes.label: Ages
modes.description: First digit of an age cutoff or age range, such as 40, 35 or 24.

modes.label: Doses
modes.description: First digit of a dose in mg, such as 40 mg or 20 mg.
